entities.summary: A formal Portuguese haute-école gala with Alter Real Lusitano horses, period costume, music and historic court exercises.
entities.description: This recommendation applies specifically to the full gala at Picadeiro Henrique Calado, not the smaller morning training sessions. The gala combines highly schooled Lusitano horses, historic costume, music and court exercises in a complete performance.
entities.whyWorthwhile: A rare, polished way to experience Portuguese court equestrian tradition as a complete live performance.
